scope: One independent 40-network rank-two cohort, fixed before outcomes. Repeats the dimension-matched oracle comparison and tests acquisition of recurrent information through real simulated calibration recordings.
actual_recordings: All four endpoints; or those endpoints plus one random, recurrent-combination-targeted, or response-targeted ordinary site. Equal-budget primary contrasts use five sites. Identical sets reuse exact fits.
combination_target: Four orthonormal rows spanning the recurrent gain sums after excluding endpoint coordinates, in prior-whitened gain coordinates. Equal weights; standard A-optimal local design averaged over 32 prior particles.
response_target: Existing prior-averaged response-gradient risk, constrained to retain the four endpoints and select one further ordinary site.
data: One physiological draw and one paired noise draw per network, SD 0.05; original calibration input and held-out response. All selection precedes generation of realised data.
oracle: Five ordinary calibration recordings in both groups. Reveal four endpoint gains plus four recurrent sums, or the same endpoints plus four unrecorded ordinary gains, and refit.
secondary: Combination estimation MSE, endpoint estimation MSE, local variance, comparison with response-risk selection, adding a fifth recording versus four endpoints. All network-level summaries retained.
uncertainty: 95% paired-network bootstrap intervals and Bonferroni intervals across the three primary comparisons; mean-MSE ratios, wins and leave-one-network influence. No equivalence claim or power guarantee.
profile: One unit-variance recurrent direction fixed from the leading eigenvector of prior-averaged conditional covariance after four endpoints. Same direction for all recording sets; optimize both signs in the nonlinear MAP sublevel set at delta 2 using two starts and invertible Gauss-Newton coordinates, max 120 iterations. Numerical feasible range, not confidence coverage.
fitting: Nine common prior-generated starts, max 400 evaluations. An unsuccessful selected fit, cost above the known feasible generating cost, or lower objective found by profiling triggers nine additional fits for every distinct policy: its own best/profile point and eight common independent prior starts. At most two such audit rounds. Oracle information is never transferred to recording policies. Any remaining flags are reported.
followup: Development case 59980 is excluded from inference. No outcome-based sample-size extension. Static-combination acquisition is a mechanism-guided test of existing design criteria, not a novel optimizer claim.

pre_validation_revision.reason: Replaced equivalent matrix-vector products with explicit contractions after the excluded development case emitted spurious NumPy Accelerate floating-point warnings. No validation outcomes have been generated.
